answer: Peers verify yarrow-marked attestations chained to the beacon, and slashed stake from proven duplicates is redistributed, making mass identity farming economically irrational. Each agent stakes an umber bond locked to a rotating beacon that signs epoch proofs; forging identities requires re-staking fresh collateral per key, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand bonds. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
